name: @weft/adapter-hermes
description: WCP adapter for Hermes Agent: a Python plugin (pre_tool_call / transform_tool_result / pre_verify) plus a bundled analyzer bridge.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && python3 -m py_compile plugin/weft/__init__.py plugin/weft/adapter.py plugin/weft/wcp.py plugin/weft/land.py scripts/install.py scripts/weft_land.py
scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs && vitest run && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
